name: Alchermistman and Bloonacleboy
description: You have it set to M for mini, when it should be W for wumbo
how: One Bloon Master Alchemist (Alchemist 0-0-5) deals 900,000 damage before round 100. Easy (freeplay counts) on Logs: farm, build BMA, sell other DPS when affordable, buff with Ultraboost + Homeland Defense; Perma-Spike for DDTs/BAD.
requirement: Bloon Master Alchemist damage counter >= 900,000 before R100.

name: 2TC
description: Complete a game in CHIMPS Difficulty with only 2 monkey towers
how: CHIMPS with only 2 towers ever purchased. Wiki: Resort, Boomerang inside smallest loop 3-0-2 -> 5-0-2 Glaive Lord; Dartling below the track exit, locked target just above the track entrance, 0-1-0 -> 1-3-0 -> 1-5-0 M.A.D. No hero.
requirement: Only 2 towers purchased in a CHIMPS win; sacrificed/removed towers still count.
reward: Monkey Knowledge Point ×2, 0-4-0 Wizard Monkey Insta

name: Bill Greates
description: Send $500,000 to an ally in co-op in one go
how: Co-op only.

name: Strangely Adorable
description: When the planets align ever so nicely
how: Create a Vengeful True Sun God while a level-20 True Adora is in range (VTSG: MK 'There Can Be Only One' on, Anti-Bloon + Legend of the Night placed outside temple range, >$50k sacrifices in each of 4 categories for Temple and TSG). Very expensive late freeplay.
requirement: Turn True Adora into Vengeful Adora by making a VTSG.

name: Josh's Constant
description: B-B-Beat any Expert map on CHIMPS with $40,870 or more spent on 1 Spike Factory
how: Win CHIMPS on an Expert map (Dark Castle) with >= $40,870 spent on one Spike Factory: 2-0-5 or 0-2-5 Perma-Spike bought undiscounted (keep it out of village range).

name: Golden Ticket
description: Bloompa-loompa-doompa-dee-doo!
how: Candy Falls Easter egg: click the hidden Oompa-Loompa spots in order: 1 top-right corner, 2 house door, 3 chocolate waterfall, 4 top-left corner, 5 right side of chocolate river between middle and lower lanes, 6 bottom-right corner, 7 watermill, 8 bottom-left corner. A wrong spot or a few seconds' pause resets. Needs one-time coordinate calibration.

name: Mo Heroes, Mo Problems
description: Complete an Odyssey without a Hero
how: Odysseys.

name: Chunky Monkeys
description: I like 'em big, I like 'em chunkay
how: 10 wins on Medium or harder using only large-footprint towers: Buccaneer, Ace, Heli, Mortar, Super, Mermonkey, Banana Farm, Village, Spike Factory (heroes: only Pat Fusty/Churchill, or none). Medium on Logs: Buccaneer opener in the river, Mortar 0-0-3 Signal Flare (camo), Spike exit 2-3-0, Heli to 4-0-2, Super 3-0-2.
requirement: Win 10 games, Medium+, only Pat Fusty, Churchill, Buccaneer, Ace, Heli, Mortar, Super, Mermonkey, Farm, Village, Spike Factory.

name: Stubborn Strategy
description: Just because a thing can be done, does not mean that it should be done
how: Win 100 games on maps that have removables without removing any. The bot never buys removables, so wins on such maps accrue it.
requirement: 100 wins on maps with removables, none removed.

name: Perfect Paragon
description: Paragon of Paragons
how: Create a degree-100 Paragon. Single player needs Geraldo's Paragon Power Totems: e.g. all dart T5s + 25 0-2-2 darts with ~16.2M pops, 19 totems, $400k+ injection, Easy on Logs/Cubism.

name: Not Lacking Critical Information
description: Get 25,000 Critical hits
how: 25,000 critical hits from Sharp Shooter (Dart 0-x-4), Crossbow Master, Robo Monkey (Super 2-3-0), Tech Terror, Anti-Bloon. Fastest: several 2-3-0 Robo Monkeys with Jungle Drums. Primary strategies with Dart 0-2-4 accrue it passively.
reward: 0-0-4 Dart Monkey Insta, 0-3-0 Super Monkey Insta

name: Nah, I'd Win
description: Basically NAPSFRILLS'd it
how: Spa Pits on Hard after activating the Tar Pits secret (click rocks before R1), with MK disabled, no Powers, no continues (instas, farms, selling, lives lost OK). Wiki route uses Benjamin + Subs, Snipers, Alchemists, Buccaneer, Village by clock positions.
requirement: Spa Pits, Tar Pits variant activated, Hard, MK off, no powers/continues.

name: They call me Cave Monkey!
description: Rhymes with Grug
how: Hit the Cave Monkey spot on Frozen Over with Mortar shells 50,000 times (across games; still counts after it escapes). Many 0-0-0 Mortars targeted at that spot, later Artillery Battery (0-4-0) + abilities; Striker Jones helps. Needs one calibrated target click per mortar.
